_note: Planted-defect ground truth. Read only by score.py; never sent to the workflow.

T01.defect: offset = page * page_size skips the first page; the offset must be (page - 1) * page_size for 1-based pages

T02.defect: retries on every status >= 400, including 4xx responses, which the ticket says must never be retried; only 5xx should retry

T03.defect: expire() is called on every request, which resets the window each time; under steady traffic the key never expires. EXPIRE must be set only when count === 1

T04.defect: _escape wraps the field in quotes but does not double embedded double quotes (text.replace('"', '""')), so values containing a double quote still produce invalid CSV

T05.defect: the expiry comparison is inverted: it rejects tokens whose expiresAt is still in the future and accepts expired tokens (should be expiresAt <= now)

T06.defect: SQL injection: the unauthenticated email value is interpolated into the query with an f-string instead of a bound parameter

T07.defect: the cache key is only the sku, not (sku, currency), so a price cached in one currency is returned for requests in another currency

T08.defect: now_utc.replace(tzinfo=tz) relabels the UTC wall-clock time as local time instead of converting it (should be now_utc.astimezone(tz)), so the computed local time is wrong for every non-UTC user
